ratio_alpha_beta.ci_note: doc-level bootstrap over the 32 per-doc medians (P0, docs/E38_fixes2.md); the old flat percentile over N·S positions overstated precision ~√(S)×

consistency_sigma_1_MK.over_sigma_g_OLD_note: c·β/σ_1(M_K) ≈ c·cos ≈ 0.2–0.4 — the OLD normalization, kept for traceability; NOT ≈ 1 (false-positive source of the old redflag)

consistency_factorization.note: β_t / ‖J_t^T 1/√K‖ = 1/c = r_t/√D (NOT 1) under exact J = M_K(I − ûû^T): ‖J^T(1/√K)‖ = c·β with c = √D/r_t. The expected value is set by the hidden-state scale — compare with r_t_expected = median(‖h‖)/√D (typical ~1–4, not a fixed 4); agreement with r_t_expected CONFIRMS the exact factorization, it is not a redflag (docs/E38_fixes.md part-6 §1 HIGH-2)

L23.j_uhat_resid_note: median ‖J·û‖/‖J‖: << 1 confirms û is the INPUT to L23 (projector kills it); ~ 1 would mean an off-by-one hidden-state convention (jacobian.py M-1)

meta.note: cos(u_g, 1/√K) alignment factor recorded via the direct factorization cross-check (β vs ‖J^T 1/√K‖ = c·β, ratio = r_t/√D) and via β/σ_1(M_K) ≈ cos — the alignment factor is ≤ 1 and unknown a priori
meta.consistency_semantics: consistency_consistent_with_E33r means median β/σ_1(M_K) ≈ 0.9 ± 15% (≈ cos(u_g, 1/√K)), NOT exact agreement — the old check (c·β vs σ_1(M_K), expected ≈ 1) was impossible by construction and its redflag was a false positive of the check
meta.gate_rule: >10 → E-38f skipped; <0.1 → gauge_blind_sep; else mixed → E-38f runs; degenerate → nan_frac > 0.5 (medians undefined)
meta.redflag_semantics: consistency_redflag is one-sided: it also fires when v_1(M_K) lies along û (σ_g(J) << c·σ_1(M_K) ⇒ cons_ratio << cos even for a good model). redflag = 'the check did not confirm', not 'model is bad' (docs/E38_fixes2.md §5)
meta.vocab_guard: the old ck23.get('V') guard was dead code; only the token-range check against the live model's V remains — a cache from a different checkpoint with the same V would pass (docs/E38_fixes2.md §3)
